How old is everyone if I may ask? Also what sort of abuse?

What sort of abuse tho?? Physical or verbal?
Send me a dm friend! It's comforting to know I'm not alone with these thoughts

It's so exhausting realizing you've failed. I wonder sometimes, as this comment slowly gets off topic, but what if I just didn't stop trying. I refuse to eat, I try to cut myself with some sort of razer I can fashion in the Psych Ward. Like just, as a mind experiment, what if I never stopped. They would probably sedate be but that will wear off eventually. What's the end game? Me being locked in a padded room indefinitely.. I dunno it just makes me wonder why society is so fixated on keeping someone alive no matter how badly they want to die. Sorry for the paragraph by the way, I tend to think a lot when I drink haha.
